question: A store has 34 sensors, including exactly 9 faulty ones. A technician uses two minutes to test each sensor once. After 40 minutes of testing, all 9 faulty sensors have been identified. How many working sensors have been tested? Show your reasoning.
source_reasoning: Testing covered 40 / 2 = 20 sensors. Of these, 9 were faulty, leaving 20 - 9 = 11 working sensors that were tested.

question: A store has 34 sensors, including exactly 9 faulty ones. A technician uses two minutes to test each sensor once. After 40 minutes of testing, all 9 faulty sensors have been identified. How many working sensors does the store have, including any that have not yet been tested? Show your reasoning.
source_reasoning: Of the 34 sensors owned by the store, exactly 9 are faulty, leaving 34 - 9 = 25 working sensors in the entire inventory.
